Maya: quick design check — screenreader behavior for the incident threshold slider feels off. VoiceOver currently says things like 'button 50' while dragging which is ambiguous. should the preview announce full context (threshold value + window + metric)? Jonathan: saw this on NVDA too. i think a full phrase is better, e.g. 'Incident threshold set to 50% over the last 5 minutes' instead of just the number. Emily: +1 for full phrase, but we should avoid spamming announcements while dragging. keyboard users also need a clear focus order: slider -> preview region -> apply button. Sam: small copy nit — prefer 'over the last 5 minutes' instead of 'in 5m' for clarity in voice. aria-ux-bot: accessibility checklist rec: use an aria-live region with polite or assertive based on urgency. debounce updates while dragging (e.g., 400-700ms) and announce a concise summary only when the user stops interacting. Maya: thinking: announce short live updates while dragging like 'Preview updated' (polite), then on stop announce full sentence 'Incident threshold set to 50% over the last 5 minutes. Notifications: slack + pager' (assertive?). open question: should we reveal configured notification channels in speech? might be noisy. Jonathan: i'd avoid listing channels during every change. maybe only announce 'notifications configured' and leave details to screen reader users who can inspect the preview pane. also ensure the preview pane has an accessible name and is reachable by keyboard. Emily: another a11y nit — the red/amber/green status pills rely on color; we need icon labels and sufficient contrast. update token usage to meet WCAG AA at smallest pill size. Sam: also add a short aria-describedby on the slider pointing to the preview copy so users know what the numbers mean. Maya: agreed. proposed action items: - add aria-live region for preview (polite while dragging, full summary after stop) - debounce to ~600ms during drag, announce full phrase on blur/stop - change copy to 'over the last 5 minutes' and 'notifications configured' wording - ensure pills have icons + text alternatives and meet contrast - keyboard flow: slider -> preview -> apply, focus stays logical after apply I'll open a doc and a tiny PR for copy + tests. sample snippet for the live region we can use: ```html
// on stop: set aria-live to "assertive" then update with full sentence ``` Maya: thanks y'all — if anyone wants to pair on NVDA testing i can set up a quick session later today. :raised_hands:
